findings.issue: Skill link target is `../../../.claude/skills/code-writing/SKILL.md` which (because of the three `../`) resolves outside `work/06-bot-connection/tasks/` to `<repo-root>/.claude/skills/code-writing/SKILL.md`. That is the correct file. However the link text prefix `[.claude/skills/code-writing/SKILL.md]` (in Task 1 only) is inconsistent with sibling tasks 2/3/4/5 which use `[skills/code-writing/SKILL.md]`. Not load-bearing but worth normalising.

findings.issue: Task 1 frontmatter declares `verify: []` (no smoke / no user). The template instructs to omit Smoke and User subsections when no checks exist — Task 1 does this correctly. The third Automated bullet ("Boot-time validation smoke (manual or via a tiny Spring test)") is in spirit a smoke check rather than an automated unit-test command. Either reclassify it under a `### Smoke` subsection (and flip frontmatter `verify` to `[smoke]`) or rewrite it as a concrete Spring `@SpringBootTest` invocation under Automated.
findings.fix: If the boot-time check is intended to run as part of unit tests, express it as a concrete gradle test command; otherwise move it under a new `### Smoke` subsection and update `verify: [smoke]` in frontmatter.

findings.issue: The line `frontend/pages/projects/[projectId]/settings.vue — текущий файл (источник кода для index.vue, перед удалением)` is plain text rather than a markdown link. All other context entries use `[name](path)` form.
findings.fix: Wrap the entry as a markdown link, e.g. `[settings.vue](../../../frontend/pages/projects/[projectId]/settings.vue) — current file (source code for index.vue, before deletion)`.

findings.issue: The Smoke subsection mostly restates the Automated unit-test scenarios rather than providing a separate executable smoke check distinct from `pytest`/`gradle test`. It is internally consistent (a unit test against MockWebServer IS the smoke for Task 2) but the surrounding prose duplicates what is already covered by the Automated subsection.
findings.fix: Either trim the Smoke subsection to a single bullet that points to the same gradle command, or remove the Smoke subsection and switch frontmatter `verify` to `[]` — the duplication is currently harmless but adds noise.
